author: nself
description: GitHub Actions self-hosted runner. Registers with your GitHub org and picks up CI jobs tagged `runs-on: ubuntu-latest` — enabling private repos to run CI without GitHub-hosted runners.

envVars.description: Token that can register runners: a fine-grained token with the organisation "Self-hosted runners: write" permission (or a classic token with admin:org)
envVars.name: GITHUB_RUNNER_PAT

envVars.description: Runner group name; empty uses the organisation default group. A group open to public repositories is refused
envVars.name: GITHUB_RUNNER_GROUP

envVars.description: Set to true to let a runner group or repository that is open to public repositories register and start (UNSAFE: fork pull requests can run on this host; warned on every start). Default false
envVars.name: GITHUB_RUNNER_ALLOW_PUBLIC_REPOS

name: github-runner
